summary: Context-only shadow memo, as of 2026-08-26: the measured tape remains risk-on and volatility is normalizing, while the risk radar is calm and receding. That surface-level resilience is not fully confirmed: no fresh C1-C7 market confirmer is present, market_confirmed remains false, liquidity plumbing shows an orderly contraction, and the confirmed US Q2 label is unsupported by its own current axes, which indicate pending Q3 after 2 of the required 7 sessions. Credit, funding, and broad market breadth remain orderly, so this is a transition/confirmation gap rather than evidence of acute stress. Factor intelligence is immature: only 11 panel dates, the history floor is unmet, Pair G is dormant, the composite is untradeable, and factor-attention authority remains A0/A1 shadow with no graded record. The kernel provides no authority to originate: all reviewed engines remain unarmed, several signed-excess families are negative, and board-family MFE results are not comparable to signed alpha. One pre-registered context hypothesis was staked for later evaluation: whether Q2-label/Q3-axis divergence plus contracting liquidity is associated with weaker 21-day signed excess for existing US-board entries. No signal, trade, score, ranking, sizing change, or escalation is originated here.
